summary: Five qualifying Charlotte multifamily comparable sales selected within 2025-09-01 to 2026-08-31, ≤8 miles, 52–116 units, stabilized, single-asset, fee-simple, unrelated-party closed transactions with positive USD consideration and size_unit=unit. Ranked by distance ascending, then most recent close: R8631 (0.8 mi, $375,000/u), R2721 (1.03 mi, $404,348/u — per executed amendment U-R2721-1), R1038 (1.26 mi, $372,973/u), R4976 (1.49 mi, $376,923/u), R1363 (1.72 mi, $375,904/u). R5793 was deduplicated against R8631 (same entity). U-R4976-3 (unsigned draft) and U-R1038-2 (effective after cutoff) were not applied.
limitations: All evaluations rely solely on the supplied packet; no external verification was performed.
Duplicate detection for R8631/R5793 relies on shared entity_id, event_date, and consideration; without underlying deed/APN detail there is residual risk of separate parcels.
R3116 excluded due to null consideration; a subsequent evidenced price could make it qualifying.
U-R1038-2 is dated after the cutoff and excluded; if effective on/before 2026-08-31 it would materially change R1038's consideration to $1 USD.
U-R4976-3 is an unsigned draft and excluded; if executed it would materially change R4976's consideration to $15,000,000 USD.
R5127 excluded because size_unit is 'acre'; unit count is not established from the packet.
Distances are as reported in the packet; no geocoding verification.
